function: Predicts the next-slot array-frequency domain channel from past LS-estimated channels (channel prediction) in wideband massive MIMO-OFDM, using aggregated learning to cut training-data collection time (p. 1, 4).
system: Uplink wideband massive MIMO-OFDM: BS 8x8 UPA (64 antennas), UE 2-antenna ULA, 128 subcarriers at 40 kHz, 2.53 GHz carrier; no RIS (p. 4, 10).
method: Aggregated learning: channel split into sub-channels pooled as one training set; MLP (also RNN, LSTM, transformer); supervised, MSE loss, online re-training from scratch (p. 5-7, 10).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa-generated channels, UMi scenario (also UMa, RMa), 2.53 GHz (p. 10, 14); training data are LS-estimated channels (p. 4-5); no measured data.
test_conditions: Trained from scratch on N time slots, tested on 100 later slots (100-slot gap) of the same UE; sweeps of mobility, UMi/UMa/RMa, pilot power (p. 5, 11, 14).
baselines: Outdated channel (OUT, no prediction); learned: separate learning SL (MLP of [10]), SL with flip augmentation, SL with MAML meta-learning [21], and joint ConvLSTM predictor [19] (p. 9-11).
metrics: NMSE (dB); achievable sum-rate; training time overhead (T_col + T_com); number of training data (p. 10-11, 15).
complexity: Training complexity orders in Table 4, e.g., O(Nepoch*Nnode*L*(N-I)*(Nnode+M(I+1))) for AL-AD; trainable parameters (Table 2) and measured GPU training time (Table 3) (p. 14-15).
q1_support: p. 10: "generator (QuaDRiGa) in [34] to generate channels" - training and test channels come from QuaDRiGa (UMi scenario), which counts as a standard model.
q2_support: p. 5: "objective is to train the network from scratch for the current" wireless environment - each new UE or environment is retrained from scratch; no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 11: "The graph labeled OUT represents the NMSE values" - outdated channel, non-learned; p. 10: "the neural network as in conventional ML-based channel" - JL, the ConvLSTM predictor of [19], plus SL x MAML of [21]; both compared on NMSE.
q4_support: p. 15: "TABLE 4. Computational complexity of AL-AD, AL-FD, SL-AD, and SL-FD." - big-O training orders of the proposed predictors; parameters in Table 2 (p. 14), measured GPU time in Table 3.
q5_support: p. 10: "generator (QuaDRiGa) in [34] to generate channels" - self-generated simulation data; no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Included as area 2 (channel prediction with MLP, RNN, LSTM, transformer). q1: QuaDRiGa counts. q2: the online framework retrains from scratch per condition (p. 5), which does not count; the MAML baseline (p. 10) adapts to a new UE but is a baseline, not the proposed method. q3: OUT plus JL [19] and SL x MAML [21]. Tables 2-4 were read from the page images.
